sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 400x300, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=35 mK; optical: 4MP CMOS
features: long-range bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible positioning PTZ
uncooled VOx thermal detector (400x300, 17 um), NETD <=35 mK
fixed 100/150 mm or varifocal 20-100 / 30-150 / 38-190 / 23-230 mm thermal lens; visible 56x-86x optical zoom
heat detection to ~9000 m; perimeter IVS to ~4830 m; human/vehicle classification

release_notes: Long-range positioning system fusing a 400x300 thermal channel with a 4MP high-zoom visible channel for wide-area perimeter surveillance (non-laser variant of the PT8441 line).

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2). PTZ via ONVIF.
